title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.3
subtitle: Shared Collider Collision Settings with a highlighted picker.

highlights.title: Linked Collider settings
highlights.description: Use the eyedropper in Collider Collision to share Motion, Friction, Collision Gap and Surface Offset. Other settings stay local. Unlink keeps current shared values.

highlights.title: Viewport picker highlights
highlights.description: Temporary cyan outlines show available Colliders and emphasize the hovered target. Amber outlines distinguish another shared group; moving requires confirmation. Picking preserves selection and the active object.

highlights.title: Detach caption inside the tab
highlights.description: Release to detach now appears inside the fading red tab, directly to the right of the trash icon. Baked playback and cache preservation remain unchanged.
